title: True or false: Capital cities, Oceania
intro: Decide whether each statement about Oceania is true. Every answer shows its source.

statements.text: Port Moresby is the capital of Papua New Guinea.
statements.explain: Port Moresby is the capital of Papua New Guinea.

statements.text: Tarawa is the capital of Solomon Islands.
statements.explain: The capital of Solomon Islands is Honiara, not Tarawa.

statements.text: Melekeok is the capital of Palau.
statements.explain: Melekeok is the capital of Palau.

statements.text: Melekeok is the capital of Vanuatu.
statements.explain: The capital of Vanuatu is Port Vila, not Melekeok.

statements.text: Suva is the capital of Fiji.
statements.explain: Suva is the capital of Fiji.

statements.text: Tarawa is the capital of Tuvalu.
statements.explain: The capital of Tuvalu is Funafuti, not Tarawa.

statements.text: Tarawa is the capital of Kiribati.
statements.explain: Tarawa is the capital of Kiribati.

statements.text: Suva is the capital of Samoa.
statements.explain: The capital of Samoa is Apia, not Suva.

statements.text: Palikir is the capital of Micronesia (Federated States of).
statements.explain: Palikir is the capital of Micronesia (Federated States of).

statements.text: Apia is the capital of Marshall Islands.
statements.explain: The capital of Marshall Islands is Majuro, not Apia.
